claim: Shutter angle is how crisp or smeared motion reads - 45 gives you the strobed, glassy sharpness of a war film, 360 gives you the smeared drift of a dream. It is the cheapest way to change how violent or how liquid movement feels without changing the movement.
not_visual: It governs how much motion is integrated per exposure, so it only shows up when the subject or camera is moving. The fixed subject sentence is a standing figure, and Animagine has a single blunt motion blur tag rather than five gradable steps.
